newsitem.title: ITALY: Alitalia faces birthday blues if controllers strike.
newsitem.headline: Alitalia faces birthday blues if controllers strike.

text.p: Italian air traffic is likely to be disrupted in Monday - the 50th birthday of loss-making flag carrier Alitalia - if a planned national strike by air traffic controllers goes ahead.
Traffic control unions have called a stoppage from 1000 GMT to 1400 GMT although civil aviation authorities said a certain number of domestic and international flights will be guaranteed.

Ministry sources said Transport Minister Claudio Burlando had called in traffic controllers' unions for a meeting on Monday scheduled for 1300 GMT and it was possible the action might be called off at the last minute.
The unions are demanding guarantees over the future of the national flight control body.

Alitalia managing director Domenico Cempella expressed "deep regret for the fact that tomorrow May 5, the 50th anniversary of the airline, service to our customers cannot be guaranteed due to a strike which has nothing to do with the company," Italian newspapers reported.
